```{r}
##########bring in COG data############
counts1 <- readRDS("counts1_branch")

mag_names <- counts1$MAG

files_dir <- "./cog_classifier"

# Build expected filenames
expected_files <- file.path(files_dir, paste0(mag_names, "_cog_result.tsv"))

# Filter to only existing files
existing_files <- expected_files[file.exists(expected_files)]

# Read and combine them, tagging each with its MAG
comb_df <- map_dfr(existing_files, ~ {
  mag_name <- sub("_cog_result.tsv$", "", basename(.x))
  read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(MAG = mag_name)
})

comb_df1 <- as.data.frame(comb_df)

#want to make boxplots comparing dispersal characteristics
#also include F8 cosmopolitans

f8 <- read.csv("../F8 mags/mag_char_f8_end_cosm.csv") %>%
  mutate(dist = str_replace_all(dist, "cosmopolitan", "F8 cosm"))

counts2.0 <- counts1 %>%
  dplyr::select(MAG, Site, GC...., dist, Completeness....) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GC_Content = 3) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Completeness = 5)

f8_2 <- f8 %>%
  select(MAG, Site, GC_Content, dist, Completeness)

counts2 <- rbind(counts2.0, f8_2)

#bring in F8 COG data
f8_cog <- read.csv("cog_output_f8.csv") %>%
  filter(MAG %in% f8_2$MAG)

comb_df2 <- rbind(f8_cog, comb_df1)

#read in UV resistance gene df
uv_genes <- read.csv("DNA_Repair_Genes.csv", header = TRUE)

uv <- comb_df2 %>%
  group_by(MAG) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
  uv_count = sum(COG_ID %in% uv_genes$COG)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-total) %>%
  ungroup(.) %>% as.data.frame(.)

disp <- full_join(uv, counts2, by = "MAG") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(uv_count = uv_count / (Completeness/100)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Completeness)

disp2 <- disp %>%
  reshape2::melt(., id.vars = c("MAG", "Site", "dist"))

# Get Kruskal-Wallis results
kw_results <- disp2 %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  kruskal_test(value ~ dist) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance() %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("p = ", round(p.adj, 3)))

# Get Dunn's test results
dunn_results <- disp2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable) %>%
  dunn_test(value ~ dist, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05)

# Calculate y positions for significance brackets
max_values <- disp2 %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(value, na.rm = TRUE))

dunn_results <- dunn_results %>%
  left_join(max_values, by = "variable") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(y.position = max_val * 1.05 + (row_number() - 1) * max_val * 0.08) %>%
  ungroup(.)

disp_plot <- ggplot(disp2, aes(x = dist, y = value, color = dist)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values=colorsc,
                      name = "Distribution") +
   facet_wrap(. ~ variable, scales = "free_y",
             strip.position = "left", nrow = 1,
            labeller = as_labeller(c(GC_Content = "GC",
                                     uv_count = "Count UV resist\ngenes"
                                     ))) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size=12),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size=10)
  ) +
  # Add Kruskal-Wallis p-value to each facet
  geom_text(data = kw_results, 
            aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) + 
stat_pvalue_manual(dunn_results, 
                   label = "p.adj.signif",
                   y.position = "y.position",
                   hide.ns = TRUE,
                   step.increase = 0,
                   facet.by = "variable")  # match your facet_wrap variable

disp_plot
```

```{r}
##########
#add in dbcan data for metabolic flexibility
# Get list of all .tsv files in the dbcan_out folder
file_list <- list.files(path = "dbcan_out", 
                        pattern = "dbcan_out_.*\\.tsv$", 
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize empty list to store results
results_list <- list()

# Loop through each file
for (file_path in file_list) {
  # Extract MAG name from filename
  # This removes "dbcan_out/dbcan_out_" and ".tsv"
  mag_name <- basename(file_path) %>%
    sub("dbcan_out_", "", .) %>%
    sub("\\.tsv$", "", .)
  
  # Read the tsv file
  data <- read.delim(file_path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  
  # Count rows where #ofTools >=
  count <- sum(data$X.ofTools >= 3, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Store result
  results_list[[mag_name]] <- count
}

results_df <- data.frame(
  MAG = names(results_list),
  num_caz = unlist(results_list),
  row.names = NULL
)

# Initialize empty list to store results, counting unique cazymes
results_list <- list()

# Loop through each file
for (file_path in file_list) {
  # Extract MAG name from filename
  # This removes "dbcan_out/dbcan_out_" and ".tsv"
  mag_name <- basename(file_path) %>%
    sub("dbcan_out_", "", .) %>%
    sub("\\.tsv$", "", .)
  
  # Read the tsv file
  data <- read.delim(file_path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  
  # Filter rows where #ofTools >= 3, get unique Recommend.Results, and count
  count <- data %>%
    filter(X.ofTools >= 3) %>%
    pull(Recommend.Results) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()
  
  # Store result
  results_list[[mag_name]] <- count
}

# Convert list to data frame
results_df2 <- data.frame(
  MAG = names(results_list),
  unique_caz = unlist(results_list),
  row.names = NULL
)

colon2.0 <- full_join(results_df, results_df2,
                 by = "MAG") %>%
  dplyr::filter(MAG %in% mag_names) %>%
  left_join(., counts1, by = "MAG") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(num_caz = num_caz / Genome.size..Mbp.) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(unique_caz = unique_caz / Genome.size..Mbp.) %>%
  dplyr::select(MAG, unique_caz, num_caz)

f8_db <- f8 %>%
  dplyr::select(MAG, unique_caz, num_caz)

colon2 <- rbind(colon2.0, f8_db) %>%
  left_join(., counts3, by = "MAG")
```

```{r}
process_tab_file <- function(tab_file, cutoff) {
  # Extract the filename without the path and extension
  filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(tab_file))
  
  # Read the .tab file
  tab_data <- read.delim(tab_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Get the cutoff value for the current file
  cutoff_value <- cutoff$cutoff[cutoff$filename == filename]
  
  # Filter the rows where column 12 is >= cutoff value
  filtered_data <- tab_data[tab_data[, 12] >= cutoff_value, ]
  
  # Create a new data frame that includes the filename and filtered data
  if (nrow(filtered_data) > 0) {
    returns <- data.frame(filename = filename, filtered_data)
  } else {
    # Return an empty data frame if no rows match
    returns <- data.frame(filename = character(), filtered_data[0, ])
  }
  
  return(returns)
}

```


```{r}
###########Looking for the presence of trace gas metbolism genes

#just get heatmap of presence of hydrogenase marker genes in MAGs
# Set the directory containing .tab files
tab_dir <- "./cosm_end_hyd_tabs"

# Get a list of all .tab files in the directory
tab_files <- list.files(tab_dir, pattern = "\\.tab$", full.names = TRUE)

#read in mapping file
cutoff <- read.csv("list_genes_mags_hyd.csv", header = TRUE)

all_hits <- data.frame()

for (tab_file in tab_files) {
  hits <- process_tab_file(tab_file, cutoff)
  all_hits <- rbind(all_hits, hits)
}

all_hits2 <- all_hits %>%
  dplyr::select(filename, V1)

cutoff2 <- cutoff %>%
  dplyr::select(filename, full_gene_name, Metabolism)

all_hits3 <- all_hits2 %>%
  left_join(., cutoff2, by = "filename") %>%
  dplyr::select(-filename, ) %>%
  dplyr::rename("MAG" = "V1")

all_hits3$MAG <- sub("_final.*", "_final", all_hits3$MAG)

marks1 <- marks0 %>% dplyr::select(-X) %>% dplyr::rename(full_gene_name = gene_f)

all_hits3.5 <- rbind(marks1, all_hits3) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Metabolism %in% c("Phototrophy", "Co Oxidation", "Group 1 hydrogenases",
                                  "Group 2 hydrogenases", "Group 3 hydrogenases", "Group 4 hydrogenases",
                                  "Carbon Fixation"))


############# F8 Data
marks2 <- read.csv("Metabolic_marker_MAGs_all_f8.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Metabolism %in% c("Phototrophy", "Co Oxidation", "Group 1 hydrogenases",
                                  "Group 2 hydrogenases", "Group 3 hydrogenases", 
                                  "Group 4 hydrogenases",
                                  "Carbon Fixation")) %>%
  rename("full_gene_name" = "gene_f")

marks3 <- rbind(marks2, all_hits3.5)

counts6 <- counts1 %>% select(MAG, Phylum, Class, dist)
f8.5 <- f8 %>% select(MAG, Phylum, Class, dist)
mags_tax <- rbind(f8.5, counts6)

#just thermophiles
#adding in taxonomy info for bins: 0.5 containment, thermophiles
all_hits4 <- marks3 %>%
  left_join(., mags_tax, by = "MAG") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(tax = paste(Phylum,
                             Class, MAG, sep = "..")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dist))

all_hits4$Present <- 1

transc_mags <- ggplot(all_hits4, aes(x = full_gene_name, y = tax)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = factor(Present)), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = "blue", name = "Present", na.value = "grey80") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(-0.2, -0.3),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f2f2f2", colour = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80")
  ) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  facet_grid(dist ~ Metabolism, scales = "free", space = "free",
             labeller = labeller(Metabolism = label_wrap_gen(width = 10)))


transc_mags

#proportions
tot_dist <- mags_tax %>%
  group_by(dist) %>%
  summarise(total = n()) %>%
  ungroup(.) %>%
  as.data.frame(.)

metab_prop2 <- all_hits4 %>%
  group_by(Metabolism, dist) %>%
  summarise(n_MAGs = n_distinct(MAG), .groups = 'drop') %>%
```
